name: Kubernetes
description: Reads a cluster's nodes and workloads so the graph can say which customer is affected when a node drains. Reads only: it will not scale, drain or delete anything.

config.label: API server address
config.hint: Where the Kubernetes API answers, for example https://k8s.dc2.example.com:6443.

config.label: What to call this cluster
config.hint: A cluster does not know its own name. Leave it empty and the address is used.

config.label: Verify the certificate
config.hint: Turn this off only for a cluster using its own certificate authority on a network you control.

config.label: Timeout (seconds)
config.hint: A busy API server must not become an operator staring at a spinner.
